note: Card "PPD-06" (procurement-pursuit-decision): a vendor records the pursuit decision they already made for one matter, and that decision resurfaces in a later alert or listing as the vendor's own private note. site/procurement_pursuit_state.mjs is a pure model with no rendered page of its own yet -- there is no natural slot on an existing surface to splice a resurfacing note into, so this card ships the module, its render helper, and its tests, and this manifest records textual evidence instead of a screenshot. No image binaries are produced or committed for this card.
external_output_directory_note: Not applicable -- no screenshot is produced for this card.
